description: This file defines the TimeParts class which provides static methods to extract hour, minute, and second components from various time representations in spreadsheets, including handling arrays of values.

classes.name: TimeParts
classes.description: Provides static methods to extract hour, minute, and second components from various time values in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: hour
methods.description: Returns the hour component (0-23) from a time value, handling arrays and various time formats.

methods.name: minute
methods.description: Returns the minute component (0-59) from a time value, handling arrays and various time formats.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Returns the second component (0-59) from a time value, handling arrays and various time formats.
